title: Security curbs imposed ahead of President’s visit

ai.summary: Nagaland police imposed curbs ahead of President's visit, banning protests and creating no-drone zones to ensure security.

facts.claim: District Magistrate, Kohima, B. Henok Buchem, has prohibited all forms of agitation, protest, procession, rally, dharna and unlawful assembly across Kohima district with immediate effect until December 10, 2026
facts.quote: District Magistrate, Kohima, B. Henok Buchem, has prohibited all forms of agitation, protest, procession, rally, dharna and unlawful assembly across Kohima district with immediate effect until December 10, 2026.

facts.claim: Kohima Police have declared a two-kilometre radius around Lok Bhavan, Kohima, and Naga Heritage Village, Kisama, as temporary “Red Zones” and “No Drone Zones”
facts.quote: Kohima Police have declared a two-kilometre radius around Lok Bhavan, Kohima, and Naga Heritage Village, Kisama, as temporary “Red Zones” and “No Drone Zones”

facts.claim: The no-drone restriction around Lok Bhavan will remain in force from midnight of November 29 to 11.59 pm on December 2
facts.quote: The no-drone restriction around Lok Bhavan will remain in force from midnight of November 29 to 11.59 pm on December 2

ai.background_note: Nagaland police imposed curbs ahead of President's visit to ensure security, banning protests and creating no-drone zones.
